scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run validate
scripts.typecheck: for d in agent-gate bash-tidy headroom-hud ste100 custom/*; do (cd $d && bunx tsc --noEmit) || exit 1; done
scripts.validate: for d in agent-gate bash-tidy headroom-hud ste100 custom/*; do claude plugin validate $d || exit 1; done
